Maryland Delegate @JoeVogel_ offers hope for climate action in the form of a warning: "We need...folks all across our state and all across our country to continue making this an issue of concern."

Video

16 years after Citizens United started laying waste to America’s elections, Hawaii's S.B. 2471—a bill under which Hawaii would no longer grant corporations the power to spend in its politics—has passed both chambers with bipartisan support and is now one step away from Gov. Green’s desk. americanprogress.org/article…

If enacted, the American Franchise Act would roll back protections for nearly 9 million Americans who work in franchises, leaving the owners of more than 800,000 individual franchise establishments solely accountable for any workplace misdeeds and allowing corporations to escape legal consequences. ampr.gs/49gHCfA

Child care is notoriously unaffordable. But parents also know that even if they can afford a program: sometimes it’s not possible to find one. 

Is your community a child care desert?

A new pilot program offers a community-driven model to support disabled students of color as they transition out of college—underscoring the urgent need for federal investment. americanprogress.org/article…

Hawaii is steps away from becoming the first state to use its legal authority to drain corporate money from its elections—and the legal questions raised about the move have straightforward answers. Here are 7 FAQs about S.B. 2471 ⬇️ americanprogress.org/article…
Viktor Orbán’s political demise in Hungary is forcing the European Union to confront its internal divisions more directly than it has in years. americanprogress.org/article…

46% of kids under 6 live in a licensed child care desert. That’s modest progress from the 51% in 2018, but millions of families are still without access. Explore the deserts in your community with our new map 📍 americanprogress.org/feature…

Big names. Big ideas. All in one place. 

Registration for the 2026 CAP IDEAS Conference is officially open! RSVP now to learn from today's leading thinkers and doers to solve the problems facing Americans now, and keep an eye out for more speakers to be announced: capideas.org

The world must align climate & trade policies. Proactive international cooperation is the only way forward. CAP’s Ryan Mulholland & coauthors explain: inettt.org/news-blog/unilate…

"This terrible decision is part of the right-wing majority’s continued attack on democracy, civil rights, and the American people. The court is hiding behind the guise of racial neutrality to undermine civil rights laws designed to protect voters of color from racism that still persists, especially across the South." ampr.gs/4n0LaZk

The American Franchise Act would let corporate franchisors off the hook when they undermine workers’ rights and leave small franchisees solely liable for labor law violations. americanprogress.org/article…
